- The flake uses Nix to build llama.cpp with different backends:
  - Default: pkgs.callPackage .devops/nix/scope.nix
  - CUDA: pkgsCuda.callPackage .devops/nix/scope.nix
  - ROCm: pkgsRocm.callPackage .devops/nix/scope.nix
  - Windows cross: pkgs.pkgsCross.mingwW64.callPackage .devops/nix/scope.nix
- The compiler is chosen by the Nixpkgs instance (pkgs, pkgsCuda, pkgs
